candidate.rationale: Restore missing surrogate-pair handling: reject an interior start that splits a pair, and move an interior end backward before the pair instead of splitting it. Resubmission adds the required schema_version field; source and metadata unchanged.

Replace stringified JSON comparison with isDeepStrictEqual, which compares parsed values structurally: nested values compared, object member order ignored, array order/types/missing/extra members significant. Preserves response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match semantics for equal parsed values.

Repair the controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (instead of mere membership). All other behavior, exports, masking, and recent-tail preservation are unchanged.

Repair retention-tool-pair validation per contract and cases: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (new Set check) and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index rather than mere membership. Masking window and other behavior unchanged.

Restore one-to-one tool-call/result pairing: enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per cases.json requirements and extended-1/2 evidence; masking window and all other behavior preserved.
Enforce unique call IDs within each exchange and positional one-to-one pairing between each tool result and its assistant call, per cases 09-11/13-15.

Compare parsed JSON structurally, making object member order non-semantic (arrays, types, missing/extra members still significant), while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match only for equal parsed values.

Fix schema_version to are.patch-set-candidate/v1 and add a start-boundary surrogate-pair check: reject ranges whose offset begins inside a surrogate pair (e.g. 'xy😀z',3,2), while preserving the end-boundary backward adjustment and the no-progress rejection.
Reject interior-start offsets and move an interior end backward before a surrogate pair so slices never begin or end inside a pair; preserve exports and other behavior.

Restore structural JSON equality: the mutated code compared JSON.stringify strings, so reordered object keys incorrectly failed. Use isDeepStrictEqual (already imported) to compare parsed values structurally — object key order irrelevant, array order/types/extra or missing members significant — while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the scoreResponse export.

Repair controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange (Set size check) and positional one-to-one matching between each tool result and its assistant call, per evidence/cases.json cases-09/10/11/12 requirements. Masking and unrelated behavior preserved.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: restore call-ID uniqueness validation within each exchange and restore positional (index-matched) tool_call_id checking instead of membership-only matching, per evidence/cases.json requirements. Masking window and masked-content format preserved unchanged; exports and unrelated behavior untouched.
